post.summary: Search for offers based on the provided criteria
post.description: Retrieve a paginated list of offers matching specified filtering criteria, ranked by relevance. If dates are provided, only available offers for those dates are returned with exact pricing. Each offer includes basic property information.

locationBoundingBox.description: Bounding box of the search location. Overrides the searchTerm parameter

checkin.description: Check-in date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

checkout.description: Check-out date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

childrenAges.description: Ages of child guests, defaults to 10 if not specified

locale.description: Locale code in format ISO 639-1 + ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "en-US"

currency.description: Currency code in ISO 4217 format, e.g. "USD"

propertyIds.description: List of property IDs to search for specifically (max 50)

extras.description: Extra fields to include in the response. Supported values: description, photos, facilities

salesChannelId.description: Only for special cases, consult Holidu

domainId.description: Only for special cases, consult Holidu

totalCount.description: Total number of results matching the search criteria

description.description: Short text description of the offer

unit.description: Unit of the area. Either UNIT_SM (square meters) of UNIT_SF (square feet)

guestCount.description: Number of guests the offer can accommodate

distance.description: Distance in meters to the center of search region if specified, otherwise null

postalCode.description: Postal code, can be null if not shared by the provider

city.description: City name, can be null if not shared by the provider

currency.description: Currency code in ISO 4217 format, e.g. "USD"

discountAmount.description: Absolute discount amount in given currency

anyOf.description: Price information for the offer for a given travel dates

currency.description: Currency code in ISO 4217 format, e.g. "USD"

anyOf.description: Minimal daily price for a property, doesn't depend on travel dates

price.description: Price information for the offer, either for a given travel dates or as a starting price

post.summary: Get detailed information about the provided offers
post.description: Retrieve detailed static information for specified offers. The "extras" parameter allows for the inclusion of additional data points to the response. The response includes an RFC 6570-compatible "urlTemplate" for generating checkout page links with check-in and check-out dates. If some requested offers cannot be retrieved, these will be reported in the "errors" array, with the corresponding property identifier, error code, and descriptive message.

locale.description: Locale code in format ISO 639-1 + ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "en-US"

currency.description: Currency code in ISO 4217 format, e.g. "USD"

extras.description: Extra fields to include in the response. Supported values: description, photos, facilities, rooms, reviews, guestCardsAndCertificates.

domainId.description: Only for special cases, consult Holidu

salesChannelId.description: Sales channel identifier, required for filtering by sales channel

description.description: Short text description of the offer

urlTemplate.description: RFC 6570 URI template to generate checkout page link with check-in, check-out and guest information. Date placeholders must be in ISO 8601 format.

unit.description: Unit of the area. Either UNIT_SM (square meters) of UNIT_SF (square feet)

postalCode.description: Postal code, can be null if not shared by the provider

city.description: City name, can be null if not shared by the provider

currency.description: Currency code in ISO 4217 format, e.g. "USD"

price.description: Minimal daily price for a property, doesn't depend on travel dates

post.summary: Get information about the availability of given offers
post.description: Retrieve real-time prices and availability for specified properties on given dates.

checkin.description: Check-in date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

checkout.description: Check-out date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

currency.description: Currency code in ISO 4217 format, e.g. "USD"

salesChannelId.description: Only for special cases, consult Holidu

locale.description: Locale code in format ISO 639-1 + ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "en-US"

country.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format

domainId.description: Only for special cases, consult Holidu

brand.description: Only for special cases, consult Holidu

currency.description: Currency code in ISO 4217 format, e.g. "USD"

discountAmount.description: Absolute discount amount in given currency

price.description: Price for the given dates. Null if property is not available for the given dates.

daysBeforeArrival.description: Number of days before arrival from which this fee applies

free.description: Whether cancellation is free under this fee rule

percentage.description: Percentage of the total price charged as a cancellation fee

amount.description: Fixed amount charged as a cancellation fee

currency.description: Currency code for the fixed cancellation fee amount

cancellationPolicy.description: Cancellation policy for the property. Null if not available.

id.description: Property ID for which the error occurred

errors.description: List of errors for properties that could not be fetched

post.summary: Get a list of property IDs that have changed within the specified time window.
post.description: Returns property IDs with data potentially updated within the specified time range. The inventory is continuously refreshed, with more frequent updates for recent days.

changedSince.description: Start of the time window (inclusive) in ISO-8601 format from which property changes are returned, e.g. 2024-10-01T14:48:00.000Z

changedUntil.description: End of the time window (inclusive) in ISO-8601 format until which property changes are returned, e.g. 2024-10-01T16:00:00.000Z

domainId.description: Controls visibility of inventory, you should get the value from your TAM

salesChannelId.description: Sales channel identifier, consult Holidu for the correct value

changeDetectionMode.description: Controls what triggers a change event. DOCUMENT_REFRESH includes any re-indexing, DOCUMENT_CHANGE only includes actual data changes. Defaults to DOCUMENT_REFRESH

changedPropertyIds.description: List of property IDs with data updated within the specified time window.

put.summary: Create or replace LOS data for an apartment

servers.description: Affiliate provider endpoint (base URL agreed upon during onboarding).

201.description: LOS data created (first push for this apartment) ([RFC 9110 §15.3.2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-15.3.2)). The `Location` header contains the canonical URI of the new resource ([RFC 9110 §10.2.2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-10.2.2)).

204.description: LOS data replaced successfully — no response body ([RFC 9110 §15.3.5](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-15.3.5)).

BearerAuth.description: Holidu authenticates to the affiliate using an OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token ([RFC 6750](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6750)). Token exchange details are agreed upon during onboarding.

BadRequest.description: The request is syntactically invalid (malformed JSON, wrong types, etc.) ([RFC 9110 §15.5.1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-15.5.1)).

example.title: Bad Request
example.detail: Request body is not valid JSON.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid ([RFC 9110 §15.5.2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-15.5.2)). The affiliate should return a `WWW-Authenticate` header indicating the expected scheme ([RFC 9110 §11.6.1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-11.6.1)).

WWW-Authenticate.description: Authentication scheme expected by the affiliate.

example.title: Unauthorized
example.detail: Bearer token is expired or invalid.

NotFound.description: The affiliate does not recognise the apartment ID ([RFC 9110 §15.5.5](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-15.5.5)). This may indicate a mapping or onboarding issue that Holidu should investigate.

example.title: Not Found
example.detail: Apartment 'apt-99999' is not known to this affiliate.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the affiliate's maximum accepted size ([RFC 9110 §15.5.14](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-15.5.14)).

example.title: Payload Too Large
example.detail: The LOS payload exceeds the maximum allowed size of 5 MB.

TooManyRequests.description: The affiliate is rate-limiting Holidu ([RFC 6585 §4](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6585#section-4)). Holidu will respect the `Retry-After` header before retrying.

example.title: Too Many Requests
example.detail: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after 60 seconds.

InternalServerError.description: An unexpected error on the affiliate's side ([RFC 9110 §15.6.1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-15.6.1)).

LosDto.description: The Length of Stay (LOS) represents accumulated prices per check-in date and length of stay. If the map is empty, no pricing is available for the apartment.

los.description: The key is an ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) representing the check-in date. The value is a list of price configurations for that date. A single check-in date may have multiple entries with different guest counts, each representing a separate pricing tier.

LosItemDto.description: A price configuration for a specific check-in date, guest count, and currency.

guests.description: Maximum number of guests this configuration applies to (adults + kids, babies excluded). A configuration with guests=2 applies to searches for 1 or 2 guests. Multiple entries with different guest values may exist for the same check-in date, allowing tiered pricing based on occupancy (e.g., guests=2 for base price, guests=4 for a higher rate).

price.description: Accumulated prices indexed by length of stay. Element at index N represents the total price for an (N+1)-night stay starting on the parent check-in date. A value of 0 means checkout is not permitted on that day (encodes minimum stay rules). Maximum 62 entries.

ProblemDetail.description: Error response following [RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) Problem Details for HTTP APIs. Affiliates are encouraged to use this format for error responses to aid Holidu in debugging push failures.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type ([RFC 9457 §3.1.1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457#section-3.1.1)).

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
detail.example: Request body is not valid JSON.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

ApartmentId.name: apartmentId
ApartmentId.description: Holidu's unique identifier for the apartment. This ID is stable and assigned during onboarding.

Location.description: URI of the newly created resource ([RFC 9110 §10.2.2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-10.2.2)).

RetryAfter.description: Indicates how long Holidu should wait before retrying ([RFC 9110 §10.2.3](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-10.2.3)). Value is either a number of seconds or an HTTP-date.

LosMultiDate.summary: Multiple check-in dates with tiered pricing

LosSingleDate.summary: Single check-in date with one pricing tier
